newsitem.title: USA: Brooks Fiber cancels primary ACES offer.
newsitem.headline: Brooks Fiber cancels primary ACES offer.

text.p: Brooks Fiber Properties Inc said it cancelled a proposed primary offering of 4.5 million depositary shares, each representing an interest in a share of automatically convertible equity securities, or ACES.

"We have canceled this proposed offering primarily because the market price of the company's common stock has declined approximately 24 percent since the filing of the registration statement on November 20, 1996," said chief executive James Allen. "Market conditions for the overall telecom sector have become less favorable since late November."

The telecommunications company said a proposed secondary public offering of about 6.7 million shares of common stock remains in registration. The company said it expects to complete the offering on behalf of the selling stockholders by the end of January 1997.
